target: delta = Y - mean over the THREE TRAINING cells; zero-mean by construction, so no cell-blind feature can beat 0
limits: FOUR independent cell contexts. Genes and perturbations buy precision inside them; they do not create new cell states. This cannot establish a universal cell-state encoder
the held-out cell's delta is measured against three cells that exclude it, so it carries a systematic offset no model trained on the other three can learn. That caps the achievable r
context is baseline RNA only -- accessibility and protein are absent for these four lines. A null is a null for RNA state, not for cell state

K562 is not re-derived while the other three are pseudobulked here; the processing asymmetry lies along the cell axis, which is the axis measured. See dense_response.json for the cross-line variance correlations that make it inspectable
the perturbation set is the ~1,763 knockouts screened in all four lines, which is a biased subset: perturbations chosen to be screened everywhere are not a random sample
verdict: 0/7 CRITERIA MET: on a 100%-dense 4-cell rectangle with the shared response frozen out by construction, the relational residual reaches r +0.0622 against a zero-contrast baseline of 0.0000 and a CROSS-CELL minimum detectable increment of 0.1698 (the seed-only floor of 0.0269 is 7x too small and is not what this is graded on -- seeds measure optimiser noise, not transfer to an unseen cell). THE DECISIVE NUMBER is the counterfactual swap: handing the trained model another cell's baseline changes r by -0.0375 against a 0.1357 floor, per-cell before averaging. In every previous experiment in this project that quantity was between -0.0007 and +0.0004 -- indistinguishable from the channel not existing. It is STILL not separated from zero, which means the objective change did not make the channel readable and the limit is the information in baseline RNA, not the loss. Real neighbours vs random partners: +0.0380. THE LADDER: the best non-learned rung is 'E nearest-cell copy' at r +0.0674 against the model's +0.0622 -- A TRIVIAL BASELINE MATCHES OR BEATS THE MODEL, so the architecture is not what produced the gain. Four independent cell contexts is the binding limit and no result here generalises past them.
